caption: melodic 80s synthwave, clear female vocals, emotional singing, analog synthesizers, punchy drums, space exploration
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Drifting through the cosmic deep
Where forgotten stars still weep
Signals calling in the cold
Stories waiting to be told

[Chorus]
We are the light in the silent void
Dreams that can never be destroyed
Hold the line through the endless night
Till the shadows turn to light

[Verse 2]
We close our eyes so to sleep
For there were not seen when we weep
Signals calling may be bold
Dreams are stories never told

[Chorus]
We are the light in the silent void
Dreams that can never be destroyed
Hold the line through the endless night
Till the shadows turn to light
